maria_cs: Heads-up — Tidepool dedicated bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PT. Final runbook + checklist attached. Need quick confirms on quota, autoscale policy, and loadtest timeline. @ben_ops @ingrid_sre @max_eng :wave:
ben_ops: Quota snapshot: reserved 500 units / day, burst to 800 for first 24h. I've allocated 6 GPUs to the pool for priming. Doc: https://intra.redwood/tidepool/quota (internal).
ingrid_sre: SLOs to validate during the run: p95 latency <150ms, error_rate <0.5% during 5k rps soak. I'll enable extra sampling and a temporary trace tail. Also request a runbook link in the dashboard.
max_eng: Model pinned to tidepool-v3.2-quant. KV cache priming script ready. Loadtest command: `./tools/loadtest --rps 5000 --seq 512 --duration 60m --model tidepool-v3.2-quant`
ben_ops: Autoscale proposal: min_replicas=4, target_concurrency=16, cooldown=60s. Fallback policy: if util>90% for 2m, shift to tidepool-v3.2-small. Thoughts?
maria_cs: Sounds reasonable. Enablement note: customer wants a 30–45m walkthrough right after smoke sign-off (09:30 PT). Renewal flag: their renewal committee expects 60% utilization by renewal review — if we fail to get them comfortable on capacity automation that becomes a risk.
max_eng: We'll run a shadow burn-in at 06:30 PT (pre-rollout) to validate priming. Staging command to apply config: `kubectl apply -f /ops/tidepool/priming-config.yaml`. I'll push artifacts to staging by EOD.
ci-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: capacity-config v1.7 applied to dedicated-pool-tidepool by max_eng at 1778881400
ben_ops: Load script ready: `s3://infra-scripts/tidepool/burnin.sh`. Plan: 15m ramp, 1h steady @5k rps, 15m rampdown. Will stream logs to #eng-oncall.
ingrid_sre: I'll create temporary alerts: error_rate >0.3% (pager), p95 latency >200ms (warning). Also adding a dashboard tile for cache-hit ratio and token burn. Ops channel for alerts: #eng-oncall-alerts.
maria_cs: @ben_ops please confirm warmup checklist items: pool reserved, autoscale policy applied, KMS access validated, runbook link shared. After smoke-run we'll sign off to the customer and update the renewal tracker.
ben_ops: Warmup checklist status: reserved ✅, autoscale applied ✅, KMS access pending (waiting for keys from secops) — ETA 30m, runbook link shared ✅.
max_eng: If KMS doesn't arrive in time we'll use ephemeral keys for warmup only (documented fallback). Also enabling aggressive prefix caching for first 30m to speed priming.
maria_cs: Got it — I'll ping the customer and offer to shift the enablement window if KMS blocks us. Posting results to this thread once smoke completes.
max_eng: Smoke run (pre-roll) results: p95 120ms, error_rate 0.12%, cache_hit 74%, reserved consumption ~48%. No KMS block — it was a missing env flag (fixed). Logs: https://logs.redwood/tidepool/smoke/177888
ben_ops: Starting 1h soak now. Will report any anomalies.
ingrid_sre: Alerts quiet so far. Trace @sample-rate=20% shows no hotspots.
maria_cs: Awesome — signed off to customer on green. Updating renewal tracker and marking go-live readiness as "on-track". Thanks all :tada:
ben_ops: +1
max_eng: nice work
ingrid_sre: :thumbsup:
ci-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: soak-run started by ben_ops at 1778881520
